narrative.intro: Spencer Construction obligated $2.4B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Spencer Construction won 5 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $472M. Spencer Construction obligations are up 320955.0% year over year. Prior-year activity was limited: FY22 obligations were $15.3M, FY23 obligations were $72.9K, and FY25 obligations were $735K. The current-year totals are partial because the period covered is FY2026 to date. The FY2026 obligations represent the bulk of Spencer Construction’s recorded federal activity across the years shown. Stakeholders tracking federal work should note the concentration of obligations in FY2026 and the relatively small award totals in the intervening years.
